claycode.delta: Production evidence must close semantic preservation + resource lifetime + authority closure separately. Conflicting async choices require explicit execution identity unless serialized H1 wins the discriminator. MVC state remains generic typed/versioned state; no dedicated primitive justified. Strict LALR workflow exists but durable diagnostic receipt was absent at screening cutoff.

hyperposition.delta: No new independent evidence changes reducer-first claim state. Cross-representation experiments should nevertheless use semantic intervention mappings so representation changes do not create fake causal differences.

claygraph.delta: Source-family ancestry/diversity should prevent correlated descendants from masquerading as independent reversal evidence. RAB is narrowed to an anti-echo candidate because context-aware scalar state already solves ordinary bifurcation and high diversity can slow adaptation.
claygraph.counterhypothesis: source-correlation-weighted scalar matches RAB with less state/cost

unifieddb.delta: Persist semantically conflicting async choice receipts, learner/version/rollback lineage, source-family ancestry and intervention mapping identities. Keep scoped commit freshness and logical unification; no final physical merge claim.
unifieddb.counterhypothesis: serialized authoritative runtime reduces choice-receipt burden
unifieddb.next_test: crash/replay and sparse/dense storage/query cost on Ubuntu
